newsitem.title: UK: NatWest Markets appoints Hall COO, rejigs.
newsitem.headline: NatWest Markets appoints Hall COO, rejigs.

text.p: NatWest Markets, the investment banking arm of National Westminster Bank Plc, said on Mondy it had appointed Peter Hall to be President and Chief Operating Officer, reporting to Chief Executive Martin Owen.
The bank also announced a reorganisation of its operating units and that its fund management arm, Gartmore, would also report directly to Owen.
Hall is currently deputy chief executive and head of NatWest Markets North America and will relocate to London by the end of the year.
Michael Allsop, currently global head of specialised finance will become president and regional managing director of NatWest Markets North America.
NatWest Markets also said it will restructure its Global Financial Markets division which was comprised of Global Capital Markets, including fixed income, and Global Treasury.
Global Capital Markets will combine with specialised finance to form Global Debt Markets division under co-chief executives Konrad "Chip" Kruger and Gary Holloway.
Global Financial Markets will include foreign exchange, money markets, currency derivatives and interest rate trading under chief executive and group treasurer Stephan Harris.

"We have emerged from an intense period of development, following the acquisitions of Gleacher, Gartmore, Greenwich and Hambro Maganas well as the organic growth of our Global Equities, Specialised Finance and Tresury businesses," Owen said.
Fast growth had brought the conclusion that the day-to-day operational management should be seperated from the strategic development, client development and financial supervision, Owen added.
On the bank's reorganisation, Owen said the intention was "to create the platform for end-to-end provision of debt -- from origination and structuring to risk management and distribution."
Owen said the seperation of Gartmore recognised the fact that the fund management arm operated as a "discrete" business for regulatory purposes.

He said Gartmore would continue to exploit opportunities with NatWest's corporate and institutional clients as well as with retail clients through the NatWest Group franchise. -- Joe Ortiz, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
